objective: Falsify or promote non-index-calculus mechanisms for generic prime-field ECDLP using matched random-group controls and end-to-end cost accounting.

shared_contract.curve_scope: prime-order short-Weierstrass curves over generic prime fields

tasks.title: Build shared generic-group control suite
deliverables: uniform toy ECDLP corpus across multiple primes and curves
operation, wall-time, memory, and preprocessing accounting
tasks.falsification_gate: Control suite must detect injected coordinate leakage and scalar-label leakage before any research lane runs.

tasks.title: Synthesize adaptive generic-group walks
deliverables: bounded policy grammar for jump selection and distinguished points
tasks.promotion_gate: Statistically significant reduction in normalized group operations against the strongest matched rho baseline, replicated across held-out curves.

tasks.title: Search for low-complexity scalar predicates and invariants
tasks.promotion_gate: A reproducible nontrivial scalar predicate whose evaluation and composition imply a concrete ECDLP advantage.

tasks.title: Probe spectral and dynamical signatures
deliverables: sampled transition and Koopman operator estimates
tasks.promotion_gate: A stable feature that predicts useful walk progress or improves collision search after overhead.

tasks.title: Test self-supervised latent linearization
deliverables: cryptanalytic use test rather than embedding-quality metrics alone
tasks.promotion_gate: Embedding yields a verified predicate, interval reduction, or collision strategy that survives matched random-group controls.

tasks.title: Triage partial-information, lifted, circuit, and correspondence lanes
deliverables: minimal toy probe for viable candidates
ranked recommendation for a later batch
tasks.promotion_gate: At least one lane has a public computable mechanism and a falsifiable path to algorithmic advantage.

tasks.title: Audit positives for leakage and disguised index calculus
deliverables: independent verdict for every claimed positive
tasks.falsification_gate: Any result failing a matched control or requiring hidden scalar-dependent preprocessing is marked DOES_NOT_SURVIVE.
